scenario.situation: The student has been living in Dubai for a few months and meets an Emirati friend at a café on the Jumeirah beach to catch up.
scenario.otherRole: A close Emirati friend who wants to hear everything.
scenario.goalEnglish: Talk about your new flat and neighbours, a recent trip, how you feel about life in Dubai, give your opinion on a new series, and make plans with conditions for next weekend.
